description: Maanpinnan mallinnus hulevesien kannalta is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Blom Kartta Oy. Optech's Titan laser scanning system's point cloud data differs slightly from other laser scanning data so that in the Titan instrument, the scanning takes place simultaneously at up to three separate wavelengths and from them separate laser pulses from all three channels can be recovered. Coverage: Blom Kartta Oy. The portal shows the English title as "Land surface modelling for stormwater" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Blom Kartta Oy. Its keywords include mallinnus, hulevesi, maanpinta. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
